name: Olite / Erriberri (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Olite (a castle and a tree on red within a bordure of the chains of Navarre).
history: The flag of Olite is formed of a rectangular cloth of proportion 2/3, white, with the arms of the city in their tinctures at the centre; the arms have a bordure gules with the chains of Navarre or.

features.role: Olite arms — castle and tree on red within a bordure of the chains of Navarre
chains, castle and crown of the arms
